Former AAP candidate found dead in Rajkot; live-in partner accused

Nandini Bosmiya, a former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) candidate from Rajkot, was found dead. She was reportedly living in a live-in relationship with a married man named Aslam. Police are investigating the death, with Aslam facing accusations.
